pantry_pkg_label: R300 additions below (2026-07-25): container sizes from board comparison rows / walmart-r300-raw.txt / labels-r300.json. Sweet Soy uses the map's 38 g/floz density (kecap manis is syrup-dense), so 20.2 floz = 768 g. Jerk Seasoning deliberately ABSENT: no sourced container size - engine flags it rather than guessing.

gpu = pulled skinless meat per bird. Board cheapest is the Sam's Club warehouse-class bird (5-6 cups / 700-840 g yield); 700 is the LOW end so cost is not understated. Recipe grams are COOKED pulled meat.
